name: Cyclone Benchmark
description: A benchmark designed to evaluate performance (throughput, latency, scalability) of graph database systems using standardized workloads.
general_score_metric: throughput (operations per second) with latency percentiles as secondary metrics
reputation: A niche systems benchmark referenced in academic work for graph database performance evaluation but not a broadly adopted community standard.
notes: Non-LLM systems benchmark; results are highly hardware- and configuration-dependent; workloads may not cover all real-world query patterns and can be sensitive to dataset/schema design.
